title: How to reset your password
body: Click Forgot password on the login page and follow the emailed link. Links are valid until used.

title: Troubleshooting failed file uploads
body: Attachments are limited to 10MB. If an upload fails, check the file size and your connection, then try again.

title: Understanding ticket priorities
body: Low: no immediate impact. Normal: standard queue. High: workflow blocked. Urgent: outage or data loss.

title: Setting up a webhook
body: Admins can configure outbound webhooks under Admin → Webhooks. Use the Test button to confirm delivery.

title: Managing your API tokens
body: Generate a personal API token from your account menu. Treat it like a password — anyone with it can act as you.

title: Inviting teammates to your organization
body: Ask an admin to add your teammate's email under Admin → Users.

title: Saved views: filtering your ticket queue
body: Save a status/priority filter combination from the Tickets page so you can get back to it in one click.

title: What happens when a ticket is closed
body: Closed tickets are archived from the default queue but remain searchable. Replying to a closed ticket reopens it.

title: Understanding organizations
body: Each customer belongs to one organization. Agents and admins can see tickets across every organization.

title: Contacting support outside business hours
body: File a ticket any time — our on-call team monitors urgent-priority tickets 24/7.
